sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek Ranger District Campground Status and Road Status tables)

values.note: 2026 and 2027: $27 a night. One vehicle included; each extra vehicle $8 a night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231856/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19 and 2027-05-14 to 2027-09-18: 'PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC': 27) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/cold-springs-campground ('Single Site: $27 per night') + recreation.gov notice ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/cold-springs-campground ('There are no electric/water/sewer site hook-ups at this campground') + recreation.gov notices ('No RV water connections are available', 'Utility hookups are not available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 38 sites, 31 of them suitable for RVs; also five walk-in tent sites. Parking spurs 25-50 ft; sites 1-5 and 9-11 are pull-overs that won't take slide-outs or large RVs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/cold-springs-campground ('There are 38 sites in the campground, 31 of which are suitable for RV camping'; 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 50 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231856 ('The maximum vehicle length that can be accommodated is 40 feet'; 'Sites 1 through 5 are pull-over's ... not suitable for RVs with slide-outs. Sites 9 & 11 are pull-over's'; notice 'Sites 1-5, 9 and 10 will not accommodate RVs with slide-outs') + catalog (32 RV/trailer sites: Back-In 22, Parallel 7, Pull-Through 3; Max Vehicle Length 20-45), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/cold-springs-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231856 ('Water hydrants, tent pads, vault toilets and trash service are provided'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek Ranger District Campground Status: Cold Springs, 'May 15 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations close 4 days before arrival; a site not occupied within 26 hours of the start goes to walk-ups. A few sites are first-come. 14 nights in any 60 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231856 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notices 'The campground has limited first-come, first-served sites', 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours ...') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19) + catalog (5 drive-in sites and the walk-ins not reservable), read 2026-10-28

note: Clear Creek RD (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), beside CO-119 on the Peak to Peak Byway five miles north of Black Hawk, among aspen and lodgepole pine at 9,200 ft. Gravel interior roads; a playground and a short steep trail to views of the Mount Evans Wilderness. --Claude
